core.title: Back-to-Back 36 Inch Modern Offset Pulls, Pair, Deltana SSPOBB36

text.description_html:
Deltana SSPOBB36, 36 Inch Modern Offset Stainless Steel Back-to-Back Door Pull Set

The Back-to-Back 36" Modern Offset Pulls have an overall length of 36 inches and a 1.5 inch grip. This pair of stainless steel handles comes packaged as a complete set, including 2 pulls and the mounting hardware to install them on wood, fiberglass, metal, or glass doors. The Modern Offset Stainless Steel Back-to-Back Door Pull Set is available in 2 finishes: brushed stainless steel, or matte black. No matter which finish you choose, the base will be constructed of high-quality stainless for a lasting and modern look.

Packaged with Back to Back mounting (2 door pulls bolted to each other - 1 door pull for each side of a door). Includes rosettes to securely tighten the door pulls to the door.

Specifications of the Deltana Square Stainless Steel Handle Back to Back Pair:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Total Length: 36"
  • Center to Center: 34.5"
  • Pull Handle Face: 1.5"
  • Pull Handle Thickness: 1"
  • Offset: 4"
  • Door Thickness: for doors up to 3" thick
  • Includes installation hardware required for glass, fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.
  • Deltana SSPOBB36 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

*Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back to Back mounting.
